payload.title: Expose qualified direct-base RI through existing native source navigation
payload.summary: Priority2 INTEGRATION. Existing Python direct-base analysis and typed graph BASES_ON support are maintained and tested. Native RepositoryMapNavigation supplies functions/classes/methods/references only, and source_relationships exposes references only, so the worker cannot obtain the existing qualified inheritance evidence through its navigation interface. Extend that existing bounded surface to consume the current direct-base owner rather than create another graph or Python resolver.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: explicit-root class relationships traverse qualified same-module/imported/module-qualified supported bases in admitted scope and preserve native derivation/occurrence/snapshot identities; unsupported computed/decorated/shadowed/ambiguous cases remain qualified and never become runtime MRO claims. Bound output and preparation; reject stale/foreign handles; refresh after edit; metadata grants no editable observation. Demonstrate actual ToolRunner response, exact-source follow-up and admissible current-source edit. Record any genuine model selection separately; no effectiveness claim from availability. Do not implicitly add membership/mirror policies or automatic ranking.
payload.uncertainty: Native map currently intentionally uses a subset. This is an enhancement, not a false claim the graph builder lacks base support. Existing CodeGraph proposal remains a broader external exploration, not this concrete missing in-repo adapter. A small supervised maintenance task is feasible after byte/scope preflight.
